title: Replace the Substring for Balanced String
description: Find the minimum length of the substring that can be replaced to make the string balanced (each character appears n/4 times).
pseudocode:
1: let n = s.length, target = n / 4
2: let count = {Q:0, W:0, E:0, R:0}
3: for char of s: count[char]++
4: let res = n, left = 0
5: for right = 0 to n - 1:
6:   count[s[right]]--
7:   while left < n and count[Q] <= target and count[W] <= target and count[E] <= target and count[R] <= target:
8:     res = min(res, right - left + 1)
9:     count[s[left]]++
10:    left++

steps.note: String length is 4, target for each char is 1.
Count chars: Q:4, W:0, E:0, R:0
Expand right: index 0 (Q). Count: Q:3, W:0, E:0, R:0
Expand right: index 1 (Q). Count: Q:2, W:0, E:0, R:0
Expand right: index 2 (Q). Count: Q:1, W:0, E:0, R:0
Shrink window. Count: Q:2, W:0, E:0, R:0
